requirements.note: GPA3.0+ undergraduate and/or prior graduate; science/health degree or experience. Chemistry, biochemistry, physics, biology preparation; advanced mathematics recommended. Central page says international GRE required for some programs, while legacy2023 FAQ says all; department page does not resolve it. Three academic recommendations required.

funding.note: All PhD students in good standing receive stipend; undated page quotes $32,000 annually. Tuition and fee waiver stated; graduation fees remain. Handbook makes eligibility subject to annual performance review and full-time status; confirm charges and insurance in offer.
